Terms.title: Shuruudaha iyo Xeerarka
Terms.intro: Akhri shuruudahan ka hor intaadan adeegsan InvestorHub iyo adeegyada uu bixiyo.

introduction.title: 1. Hordhac
introduction.content: Ku soo dhowow InvestorHub. Markaad isticmaasho mareegtan ama adeegyadeeda, waxaad aqbashay shuruudahan. Haddii aadan aqbalin, ha isticmaalin adeegyada.

accountRegistration.title: 2. Diiwaangelinta Akoonka
accountRegistration.content: Adeegyada qaarkood waxay u baahan yihiin akoon. Bixi xog sax ah oo ilaali xogta gelitaanka akoonkaaga.

investmentTrading.title: 3. Maalgashi iyo Ganacsi
investmentTrading.content: Maalgashiga iyo ganacsigu waxay leeyihiin khatar. Xogta madalku ma dammaanad qaaddo faa'iido ama natiijo maaliyadeed.

paymentsWithdrawals.title: 4. Lacag-bixin iyo La-bixid
paymentsWithdrawals.content: Hubi in xogta lacag-bixinta iyo la-bixistu sax tahay. Waqtiga iyo shuruuduhu way ku kala duwanaan karaan adeegyada.

userResponsibilities.title: 5. Waajibaadka Isticmaalaha
userResponsibilities.content: U adeegso madasha si sharci ah oo masuuliyad leh. Ha faragelin madasha, ha gelin akoon qof kale, hana samayn khiyaano ama hawl aan la oggolayn.

limitationOfLiability.title: 6. Xaddidaadda Mas'uuliyadda
limitationOfLiability.content: Inta sharcigu oggol yahay, InvestorHub mas'uul kama aha khasaaraha ka dhasha isbeddelka suuqa, ciladaha farsamo, ama xaalado ka baxsan awooddayada macquulka ah.

changesToTerms.title: 7. Isbeddelka Shuruudaha
changesToTerms.content: Waxaan mararka qaarkood cusboonaysiin karnaa shuruudahan. Isbeddelladu waxay dhaqan gelayaan marka halkan lagu daabaco. Adeegsiga madasha ka dib waxay ka dhigan tahay inaad aqbashay shuruudaha cusub.

privacy.label: Asturnaanta
privacy.title: Siyaasadda Asturnaanta
privacy.intro: Qaybtani waxay sharxaysaa sida InvestorHub u ururin karo, u adeegsan karo, una ilaalin karo xogtaada.

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Xogta Aan Ururinno
informationWeCollect.content: Waxaan ururin karnaa xogta aad bixiso markaad samaysato akoon, nala soo xiriirto, ama isticmaasho adeegyadayada. Waxaa ka mid noqon kara magacaaga, xiriirkaaga, iyo xogta akoonka.

howWeUseInformation.title: 2. Sida Aan Xogta U Adeegsanno
howWeUseInformation.content: Xogta waxaa loo adeegsan karaa bixinta iyo hagaajinta adeegyada, xiriirka isticmaalayaasha, ilaalinta akoonnada, fulinta codsiyada, iyo waajibaadka sharciga.

informationProtection.title: 3. Ilaalinta Xogta
informationProtection.content: Waxaan qaadnaa tallaabooyin macquul ah si aan u ilaalinno xogta. Si kastaba, ma jiro nidaam elektaroonig ah oo gebi ahaanba ammaan la dammaanad qaadi karo.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies
cookies.content: Mareegtu waxay adeegsan kartaa cookies si loo ilaaliyo gelitaanka, loo hagaajiyo shaqada, loona fahmo sida loo isticmaalo madasha.

thirdPartyServices.title: 5. Adeegyada Qolada Saddexaad
thirdPartyServices.content: Madashu waxay adeegsan kartaa adeegyo kale oo lacag-bixin, gelitaan, falanqayn, ama martigelin ah. Adeegyadani waxay xogtaada u maamuli karaan si waafaqsan siyaasaddooda asturnaanta.

yourRights.title: 6. Xuquuqdaada
yourRights.content: Iyadoo ku xiran sharciga, waxaad xaq u yeelan kartaa inaad codsato helitaanka, sixidda, ama tirtiridda xog gaar ah oo aan kaa hayno.

contact.title: 7. Xiriir
contact.content: Haddii aad su'aalo ka qabto shuruudahan ama siyaasadda asturnaanta, la xiriir kooxda taageerada.

about.label: Nagu Saabsan
about.description: InvestorHub waa madal dijitaal ah oo fududaysa maareynta maalgashiga. Hal meel ayaad ka maamuli kartaa akoonkaaga, ka eegi kartaa xogta maalgashiga, kana la socon kartaa hawlahaaga.

leadership.title: Maamul Maalgashigaaga Si Fudud
leadership.message: Maalgashigu wuu adkaan karaa. Waxaan fududaynaynaa maaraynta akoonka, la socodka maalgashiga, iyo helitaanka xogta muhiimka ah.

whatIsInvesting.title: Waa maxay maalgashi?
whatIsInvesting.description: Maalgashi waa inaad lacag geliso hanti ama fursad adigoo rajaynaya faa'iido mustaqbalka. Waxaa ka mid noqon kara saamiyo, curaarta, hanti ma-guurto ah, ganacsiyo, iyo hanti kale.

investmentTypes.title: Maalgashi noocee ah ayaa jira?
investmentTypes.description: Fursadaha waxaa ka mid noqon kara saamiyo, curaarta, sanduuqyo maalgashi, hanti ma-guurto ah, badeecooyin, hanti dijitaal ah, iyo fursado kale. Waxay ku xiran yihiin adeegyada la bixiyo.

howToStart.title: Sideen ku bilaabaa?
howToStart.description: Samee akoon, buuxi xogtaada, kadibna eeg adeegyada maalgashi ee kuu bannaan. Waxaad hawlahaaga ka maamuli kartaa akoonkaaga.
